name: Akishima Yuka
source:
Yuka is [url=https://vndb.org/c941]Himeko[/url]'s long time best friend. She is a bit of a not-true-to-herself type and often dresses in frilly kind of clothing. Unlike Himeko, Yuka is more girlish.
